market_question: Will Trump and Putin meet next in another EU country?
reasoning: Market implies only 0.4% probability of a meeting in an EU country by June 2026. With Trump in office and clear intent to engage Putin on Ukraine, a face-to-face encounter within the 15-month window is plausible (~35–50%). Past US-Russia summits (Helsinki 2018) show EU venues are realistic, though Saudi Arabia has been floated. Conditional on a meeting, an EU country (even excluding Finland if 'another' applies) still holds ~10–15% chance, yielding ~4.5% overall – a nearly 10× discrepancy.
evidence_points: Trump has repeatedly expressed desire to meet Putin, including directly after inauguration 2025, making a summit likely within 15 months.
Previous Trump-Putin summit in Helsinki (EU member) establishes precedent for EU venues, despite recent Saudi/UAE speculation.
No meeting by June 2026 is a possibility, but even a conservative 35% meeting probability × 12% EU conditional gives ~4.2%.
Liquid market with $990k volume may be anchoring on early Saudi rhetoric, underrating alternative neutral EU sites like Vienna or Helsinki (if not excluded).
sources_consulted: News reports on Trump-Putin call and summit speculation (Reuters, AP, BBC)
Historical data on US-Russia summit locations (Helsinki 2018, Geneva 2021)
